mapper.select: select embryo_code as material_code, sum(DAY_FINISH_QTY) as DAY_FINISH_QTY from T_CX_DAY_FINISH_QTY where FINISH_DATE BETWEEN to_date(#{finishDate}, 'yyyy-mm' ) and last_day( to_date(#{finishDate}, 'yyyy-mm' ) ) and is_delete = '0' GROUP BY EMBRYO_CODE
